The '''hideout''' was located within the ruined city of [[Cazne/Legends|Cazne]] on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and was used by the [[Twi'lek freedom fighters/Legends|Twi'lek freedom fighters]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]

==History==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], a battle broke out known as the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]] between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] after the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] invaded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. During the battle [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and two of his [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] comrades were approached by [[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla]] along with the freedom fighters and were brought to this hideout. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] convinced the fighters to help them liberate [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] from the droids.
